title: Repository permissions
note: Setup checks existing repository access live before binding. Missing access names the exact owner/repo and installation settings link; failed checks report unknown access and retry. The landing rollup reads pull requests, contents, checks and commit statuses with read-scoped tokens. Doctor needs Administration: write to see queue bypass actors but makes only GET requests. Issue and PR searches request the relevant read grants; environment listings need Actions: read. Hidden administrative, landing, queue, membership, file or search evidence is unreadable, never a match or a pass; recovery names the App permission and installation approval.
